title: Buildings' surface details packed four to a slot
items: Nothing you can see changed. Each building corner's sheen, evidence grade, wood grain and log tone now share one four-byte slot instead of taking four each, so the 1835 town's buildings hold 30.4 MB of corner data instead of 41.0 MB, 24 bytes a corner.
It is more of the memory phones were running out of. Storing the corners' positions in smaller numbers comes next.
